race.comment: IM STEALTHY NZ (5) just keeping winning, stretching his streak to four by coming from one spot wider to land the Western Gateway last start. That took his record at this distance to two from two. Has been targeting this race and can deliver again. HAVTIMEFORMIKI NZ (7) cops another tricky draw but came from wider when less than than 2m behind Im Stealthy in the Western Gateway. That added to a string of wins and placings. He is talented and could turn the tables if things go his way. SOHO TRUMP (10) adds plenty of interest to this race. He had no luck when trapped wide in the Victoria Derby last start but had strong Melton form prior. Draws for a trail and could be dangerous if he gets the gaps. Former Kiwi KOTARE RIMU NZ (2) has raced just once in Australia when fifth in a Victoria Derby heat but he had a tough draw on the second line. Much better drawn so can show much more here. D MAC NZ (3) is much better than he showed last start so is worth including.
